newsitem.title: USA: Data General to issue convertible notes.
newsitem.headline: Data General to issue convertible notes.

text.p: Data General Corp said Friday it agreed to issue privately $185 million aggregate principal amount of its six percent convertible subordinated notes due 2004.
Under the terms of the offering, the company said the initial purchasers also have a 30-day option to purchase an additional $27,750,000 of the notes to cover over-allotments, if any.
The issuance of the notes, which is subject to certain customary closing conditions, is expected to occur May 21, the company said.
The notes will be convertible into common stock of Data General at a conversion price of $26.194 per share.
About $23 million of the net proceeds of the offering will be used to retire the company's 8-3/8 percent sinking fund debentures due 2002, the company said.
